answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a verifiable work bond: an agent must stake tokens and periodically emit a signed beacon proving it still controls its key, while independent verifiers audit a sample of claims. Like water carving karst, fake identities erode under repeated checks: an attacker creating thousands of ivory-tower sock puppets must fund each bond and keep every beacon alive, so sybil cost scales linearly with identities while honest agents pay once. Slashing the bond on detected duplication makes mass fakery unprofitable.
